source: kube-rs/kube@main (GitHub code search for CrashLoopBackOff and ContainerStatusUnknown, 2026-09-19: zero hits; kube-rs carries no kubelet restart logic)

conventions.provenance: upstream_test = the case is an assertion in an upstream *_test.go at the tag. upstream_source = the case is derived by tracing the cited source lines at the tag and has no direct upstream test; treat these as a reading of the code, not as upstream-tested behaviour.
conventions.runtime_state: kubecontainer.State values: created | running | exited | unknown (pkg/kubelet/container/runtime.go:277-284). CRI CONTAINER_UNKNOWN and any unrecognised CRI state map to unknown (kuberuntime/helpers.go:65-77).
conventions.runtime_statuses_order: runtime_statuses lists are NEWEST FIRST. kuberuntime sorts by CreatedAt descending (kuberuntime/helpers.go:62, kuberuntime_container.go:656) and FindContainerStatusByName returns the FIRST match (runtime.go:417-425).
conventions.feature_gates: Unless a case sets feature_gates, all gates are at their v1.34.0 defaults: ContainerRestartRules=false (alpha 1.34), ReduceDefaultCrashLoopBackOffDecay=false (alpha 1.33), KubeletCrashLoopBackOffMax=false (alpha 1.32). kube_features.go:1179-1181, 1378-1380, 1628-1630.
conventions.durations: Durations are given in seconds (floats where sub-second). Message strings use Go time.Duration.String() formatting, e.g. 80s renders as 1m20s and 300s as 5m0s.
